summary: The review-policy side helpers of the control transactions, ported from WorkStore._ensure_review_policy / _publication_busy / _hosted_green. All functions are pub(crate) and run on the caller's open Tx.
responsibilities: ensure_review_policy: upsert coding_review_policy from the store's repair_policy (INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(owner_id,project_alias) DO UPDATE SET all fields), then INSERT INTO forge_agent.coding_review_budget(owner_id,project_alias,root_task_id,policy) VALUES(...) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING with the policy as a JSON object {version, max_rounds, max_stagnant_rounds, max_infrastructure_retries, required_hosted_checks}.

publication_busy: true when a publication row exists with status in (pending, checking, publishing); else, when the task is not awaiting_review or is not (review_required implement mode or an approved-plan implementation), false; else true when NO publication exists for the task's latest attempt with status in (published, failed). The approved-plan check: plan_decision_id non-null, mode implement, and a coding_plan_decisions row with decision resume for that decision_id.
hosted_green: the publication_required_green read query pinned in the pattern; returns its required_green bool (false when no row).
invariants: ensure_review_policy upserts from the store's repair_policy every time (the policy row is configuration, refreshed idempotently).
